messages.author: e50fa4d924dd1fdb
messages.subject: Application failing in shiny server
parts:
Hello everybody,

I am desperatly trying to deploy a shiny app into my server. But it always fails to start with this error:

Error in if (nchar(bookmarkStateDir) > 0) { : valeur manquante là où TRUE / FALSE est requis Calls: local -> eval.parent -> eval -> eval -> eval -> eval Exécution arrêtée

The relevant part of the configuration file is the following:

        location /dashboard {
        run_as francois;
         app_dir /home/francois/dashboard;
         log_dir /home/francois/dashboard/logs;
         directory_index        off;
}


Can somebody explains how to define the bookmarkStateDir to prevent this error ?

Thanks for your help.

François Valenduc
